services.pos_desc: Counter sales, pending carts, fast checkouts, and standardized invoicing.
services.stocks_desc: Real-time item tracking, stockout alerts, inventories, and supplier debts.
services.compta_desc: Daily data entry, Syscohada/OHADA chart of accounts, balances, and financial statements.
services.analytique_desc: Cost center tracking, budget preparation, variance calculation, and project profitability.
services.scolaire_desc: Enrollment tracking, class management, timetables, digital gradebooks, grades, and report cards.
services.immo_desc: Asset fleet tracking, automatic depreciation calculation (straight-line/declining balance), and inventory sheets.
services.paie_desc: Salary calculation, payslip generation, management of bonuses, taxes, advances, and installments.
services.rh_desc: Personnel tracking, leave management, employment contracts, and organizational charts.
services.rbac_desc: Strict user role access control and total traceability via the encrypted audit log.

features.pos_0: Touch interface optimized for high-throughput checkout screens.
features.pos_1: Simultaneous queuing for multiple customer shopping carts.
features.pos_2: Multi-currency management and interconnected gateways (Mobile Money, Cards, Cash).
features.pos_3: Instant generation of standard receipts and certified invoices (AIB / QR Code MeF).
features.pos_4: Secure end-of-day closing with variance logs and automated sales reports.
features.stocks_0: Real-time inventory tracking by barcodes, serial numbers, or batch lots.
features.stocks_1: Configurable alert thresholds with automatic calculation of critical stock.
features.stocks_2: Automated generation of supplier purchase orders based on stock status.
features.stocks_3: Inventory valuation according to AVCO or FIFO methods.
features.stocks_4: Rigorous tracking of unpaid supplier invoices and schedule of due dates.
features.compta_0: Revised SYSCOHADA chart of accounts natively integrated for West African compliance.
features.compta_1: Simplified data entry through auxiliary journals (Purchases, Sales, Bank, Cash, OD).
features.compta_2: One-click generation of the Trial Balance, General Ledger, and General Journal.
features.compta_3: Automated publishing of financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow).
features.compta_4: Automatic bank reconciliation via bank statement imports.
features.analytique_0: Multi-level analytical structure (Profit centers, jobs, projects, departments).
features.analytique_1: Automatic or manual allocation of expenses and revenues.
features.analytique_2: Preparation and tracking of monthly and annual provisional budgets.
features.analytique_3: Real-time comparative analysis: Allocated Budget vs Actual vs Committed.
features.analytique_4: Decision support dashboards with key profitability indicators (KPIs).
features.scolaire_0: Complete management of student lifecycles (Enrollment, re-enrollment, administrative files).
features.scolaire_1: Class mapping, teacher assignments, and dynamic timetable scheduling.
features.scolaire_2: Tuition tracking: Payment schedules, outstanding fee reminders via SMS/Email.
features.scolaire_3: Shared digital class journal and real-time attendance tracking.
features.scolaire_4: Automated calculation of class averages and generation of termly report cards.
features.immo_0: Comprehensive asset registry sheets (Acquisition date, gross value, physical location).
features.immo_1: Automated calculation of straight-line, declining, or backup schedules.
features.immo_2: Automatic generation of depreciation expense entries at fiscal year-end.
features.immo_3: Tracking of disposals, write-offs, and fixed asset revaluations.
features.immo_4: Physical inventory matching via scanning QR codes affixed to assets.
features.paie_0: Configurable payroll calculation engine tailored to local tax regulations (ITS, IGR, CNSS).
features.paie_1: Integration of monthly variable parameters (Bonuses, overtime, commissions).
features.paie_2: Automated tracking of salary advances, installments, and internal staff loans.
features.paie_3: Generation of highly secure payslips in standardized or encrypted PDF formats.
features.paie_4: One-click generation of annual salary declarations (DADS / DISA).
features.rh_0: Personnel file management and digital archiving of contracts (Permanent, Fixed-term, Internship).
features.rh_1: Leave request tracking with multi-level hierarchical approval workflows.
features.rh_2: Occupational health tracking, medical check-ups, work accidents, and certifications.
features.rh_3: Automatic generation of company organizational charts based on reporting relationships.
features.rh_4: Annual performance reviews and internal training plan tracking.
features.rbac_0: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with granular security options per function.
features.rbac_1: Permission settings: Read-only, write, modify, or delete logs.
features.rbac_2: Encrypted audit log tracking every user action with immutable timestamps.
features.rbac_3: Strong password policy enforces optional Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
features.rbac_4: Access restriction based on specific working hours schedules or dedicated IP addresses.
